title: Tenant Route Sentinel & Incident Heatstrip — Private Deployment Operational Slate
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact operational slate for Private/VPC tenants that surfaces per-tenant routing health, cross-tenant incident correlation, and a rapid rollback/mitigation rail. Deliverables: Figma prototype (compact desktop + narrow tablet), interaction spec for severity badging and mouse/keyboard quick actions, accessibility contrast checks, and handoff tokens for engineering. The slate combines three panels: 1) Route Sentinel (live path status, last-failed-hop, retryable error tags), 2) Incident Heatstrip (time-series miniheat per tenant with clickable slices to expand), 3) Rapid Remediation Rail (canary/rollback controls, runbook quick links, safe-toggle for reversible throttles). Design must integrate with existing Console top-nav and tenant selector and reuse token system from design system v2.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates all three panels with interactions (hover, click-to-expand, keyboard focus)
Severity badging follows color tokens and provides tooltip with last 3 events for each tenant
Rail contains disabled-state and confirmation modal for rollback actions
Design spec lists responsive breakpoints and accessible contrast ratios
Engineering handoff includes frame-level assets and component map
design_decisions: Compact heatstrip uses 1px row height to fit 30-day view; clicking expands to 36px for details
Severity badging is derived from combined SLO and error-rate; explicit thresholds: warning=5% error, critical=15%
Rapid Remediation Rail puts destructive actions behind a two-step confirmation and records a snapshot for automatic rollback
Default tenant list is sorted by recent incident impact, with pin/unpin support for ops favorites
notes: Prototype assumes telemetry event enrichment (path_id, last_hop_ms, region). Need infra to provide per-tenant mini-timeseries endpoint. Interaction spec drafts call out debounce behavior for live updates.
